data.title: People's Party queries B400bn loan plan
data.description: <p>The opposition People's Party (PP) has questioned energy transition plans under a 400-billion-baht government borrowing programme, warning that 200 billion baht of projects could miss their objectives and invite corruption.</p>

data.title: Pheu Thai candidate wins Kalasin PAO election
data.description: KALASIN - Pheu Thai candidate Chalermkwan Lottrakul has been elected president of the Kalasin Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) by a landslide, receiving 306,674 votes, according to unofficial results.

data.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to dock in Thailand next week
data.description: ⁠The ​aircraft carrier USS ​Abraham Lincoln is expected to dock in Thailand next week, following a prolonged deployment in the Middle East that raised concerns about conditions aboard the US Navy ship.

data.title: THAI says typhoon could disrupt Taipei, Shanghai flights
data.description: Thai Airways International has advised passengers on flights to Taipei and Shanghai on Thursday and Friday to check schedules as they could be disrupted by an approaching storm.

data.title: Palestine flag in Phuket shop angers Israelis
data.description: PHUKET - An argument between a mobile phone shop owner and two Israeli tourists over a “Free Palestine” flag has drawn attention after video of the exchange was posted on social media.

data.title: Visas revoked for threats to Samui zoo owner
data.description: The visas of foreigners who threatened the life of a private-zoo owner on Koh Samui have been revoked, Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said on Tuesday.

data.title: Acquittal overturned, Prinn gets 3 years for indecent assault
data.description: The Court of Appeal has overturned the acquittal of former Democrat Party deputy leader Prinn Panitchpakdi and sentenced him to three years in prison for indecent assault and taking a minor away from parental care for indecent purposes.

data.title: Second death sentence for serial killer ‘Aem Cyanide’
data.description: n seventh of 15 cases to be decided, court finds cyanide poisoning of creditor was deliberately planned

data.title: 100kg boar takes a stroll along the highway
data.description: A 100-kilogramme "wild boar" let out of its pen for a walk instead wandered off onto a nearby elevated highway, startling motorists and disrupting traffic on Monday. His owner took more than an hour to sweet-talk him into returning home.

data.title: S. Korea seeks Interpol help to track illegal gambling suspects in Thailand
data.description: South Korean police are hunting five suspects believed to have fled to Thailand for allegedly operating an illegal gambling site involving 60 billion won (1.5 billion baht).

data.title: Cabinet to extend social security cover to farm, street, domestic workers
data.description: The Labour Ministry will propose an expansion of social security coverage under Section 33 to include agricultural workers, street vendors and domestic workers.

data.title: Southern border rail track reopens after bombing
data.description: NARATHIWAT - Train services have resumed on the main southern line in Rangae district, following repairs, after it was damaged by a bomb on Saturday night, the State Railway of Thailand said on Tuesday.

data.title: High-tides alert for six central provinces, Bangkok
data.description: Low-lying areas in six central provinces and Bangkok have been warned to prepare for possible flooding caused by very high tides from Tuesday to Saturday this week.

data.title: Illegal hookah shop shut down in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - Authorities have seized 32 illegal hookah sets, known as “Baragu” in Thai, from a shop in Muang district that caters to tourists.

data.title: Convenience store bombed in deep South as two suspects arrested
data.description: PATTANI — Another convenience store was bombed and set ablaze in the deep South, while two suspects were arrested after a brief gunfight in this southern border province on Monday night.

data.title: People's Party says it has new proof of collusion
data.description: <p>The People's Party (PP) hinted on Monday that it would unveil new evidence this week in the alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election, as the main opposition party expressed concern that the Election Commission (EC) may take legal action against only eight people in the case.</p>

data.title: Four Thais arrested after kidnapped Chinese woman flees car
data.description: KAMPHAENG PHET - Police arrested four Thai men after a Chinese woman abducted from a hotel in Bangkok escaped from a car while being taken to Mae Sot district in Tak province, on the Myanmar border.

data.title: Committee to review cases for amnesty
data.description: <p>A special committee will review all political cases from 2005&ndash;2025 under the newly enacted Peaceful Society Promotion Act, Prime Minister's Office Minister Paradorn Prissananantakul said.</p>

data.title: PP to give more collusion proof
data.description: <p>The People's Party (PP) hinted yesterday it would unveil new evidence this week in the alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election, as the main opposition party expressed concern that the Election Commission (EC) may take legal action against only eight people in the case.</p>

data.title: KPI chief faces probe over alleged admissions scam
data.description: <p>House Speaker Sophon Zarum has ordered a fact-finding investigation into allegations that King Prajadhipok's Institute (KPI) secretary-general Issara Sereewatthanawut solicited benefits in exchange for admission to an executive programme.</p>

data.title: Dems seek NACC protection for exam case witnesses
data.description: <p>The Democrat Party on Monday urged the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) to protect people who were deceived or allegedly involved in a local civil service examination fraud scheme and retain them as witnesses to support its investigation.</p>

data.title: North runoff spurs alarm along river
data.description: <p>The Royal Irrigation Department (RID) is closely monitoring the Chao Phraya River as runoff from the upper basin increases, with authorities preparing for higher downstream water levels.</p>

data.title: Govt 'ready' to justify PM's overseas trips
data.description: <p>The government is prepared to defend Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's foreign policy and overseas trips with concrete results when parliament holds a no-confidence debate, government spokeswoman Rachada Dhnadirek said on Monday.</p>

data.title: Remote surgery 'successful'
data.description: <p>Thailand has performed its first remote robotic surgery for prostate cancer, with a surgical team in Bangkok operating on a patient about 250 kilometres away in Nakhon Ratchasima.</p>

data.title: Committee to review cases for amnesty

data.title: Business nominee crackdown widens
data.description: <p>Authorities are widening their crackdown on foreign nominee businesses and "grey capital", going beyond raids and asset seizures to trace ownership structures, financial flows and Thai shareholders.</p>

data.title: FM Sihasak kicks off Africa trip
data.description: <p>Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow begins his first official visit to Africa on Tuesday as Thailand seeks to deepen its ties with Nigeria, Ethiopia and the wider continent.</p>

data.title: Navy to extend border fence
data.description: <p>The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) will extend a border fence along the Thai-Cambodian frontier in Chanthaburi by more than 8km as authorities step up security measures along the disputed border.</p>

data.title: NIA cites 3 factors for attacks
data.description: <p>The National Intelligence Agency (NIA) has identified three possible factors behind a series of attacks at more than 50 locations in the deep South late last week, saying they could be linked to preparations for renewed peace talks and an upcoming military rotation.</p>

data.title: Judges query jail sentences
data.description: <p>The Judicial Administration Commission (JAC) has called for a review of criminal sentence enforcement amid concern that serious offenders are receiving large sentence reductions and reoffending after release.</p>

data.title: Four Thai kidnappers arrested while taking Chinese woman to Myanmar border
data.description: KAMPHAENG PHET: Police arrested four Thai men for allegedly kidnapping a Chinese woman from a hotel in Bangkok and taking her to Mae Sot district of Tak bordering Myanmar.

data.title: M82 to Ban Phaeo to open on Friday
data.description: <p>The 16.4-kilometre Ekachai-Ban Phaeo section of the M82 elevated motorway will open for free 24-hour trial use from 10am on Friday, extending the route in operation from Bang Khun Thian to about 25km.</p>

data.title: Thai passport slips in power ranking
data.description: <p>The Thai passport has slipped eight places to 99th in the world, according to a new report by passportreports.com, down from 91st last year.</p>

data.title: Rare B10 coin sells for B2.5m in first online auction
data.description: Thailand's first electronic rare coin auction on Monday featured a 10-baht circulation coin from 1990 that went under the hammer for 2.5 million baht.
